summary: Lists pods for an Operator upgrade from a 2.4 non-redundant controller-only deployment (web, task, database pods) to the 2.6 growth topology, which adds hub, EDA, platform gateway and Redis pods.
questions: What pods does the 2.6 Operator growth topology need?
What changes when upgrading a 2.4 controller-only Operator deployment to 2.6?
How many automation hub pods are in the 2.6 growth topology?
Which Event-Driven Ansible pods are in the Operator growth topology?

answer_card.title: 2.6 Operator growth topology pods
answer_card.answer_md:
Upgrading from a 2.4 controller-only deployment (1 controller web, 1 controller task, 1 database pod) to 2.6 growth topology needs:

- Controller: 1 web, 1 task pod
- Automation hub: 1 web, 1 API, 2 content, 2 worker, 1 Redis pod
- Event-Driven Ansible: 1 API, 1 activation worker, 1 default worker, 1 event stream, 1 scheduler pod
- 1 platform gateway pod
- 1 database pod, 1 Redis pod
